observation.visible_scene: A mountain landscape at dawn or dusk, featuring a steep, dark, rocky slope on the left and jagged peaks in the background illuminated by warm light. A thick layer of white fog fills the valley floor between the slopes, while pinkish clouds fill the sky. Green vegetation is visible in the foreground and a thin branch extends from the right.
visible_changes: The white fog in the valley drifts and swirls continuously, changing its shape and density as it moves through the landscape.
The clouds in the sky shift slowly, altering the pattern of light and shadow.
The distant mountain peaks remain visible through the fog, with the lighting on them staying relatively consistent.
The foreground trees and the branch on the right remain static, indicating a fixed camera position.
outside_clip_unknowns: The specific time of day (sunrise vs sunset).
The source or destination of the fog flow.
The weather conditions outside the visible frame.
uncertain_details: The exact speed of the fog movement is difficult to quantify.
Whether the light changes are due to cloud movement or sun angle are subtle.
